proof_body:
by
  intro N _ Φ
  have hc : ((∑ k, Complex.normSq (ZMod.dft Φ k) : ℝ) : ℂ) = (((N : ℝ) * ∑ j, Complex.normSq (Φ j) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    push_cast
    have e : ∀ k : ZMod N, ((Complex.normSq (ZMod.dft Φ k) : ℝ) : ℂ) = ∑ i, ∑ j, Φ i * (starRingEnd ℂ) (Φ j) * ZMod.stdAddChar (k * (j - i)) := by
      intro k
      rw [← Complex.mul_conj, ZMod.dft_apply, map_sum, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_))
      simp only [smul_eq_mul, map_mul]
      rw [← AddChar.map_neg_eq_conj, mul_sub, sub_eq_add_neg, AddChar.map_add_eq_mul]
      have e1 : ZMod.stdAddChar (-(i * k)) = ZMod.stdAddChar (-(k * i)) := by rw [mul_comm]
      have e2 : ZMod.stdAddChar (- -(j * k)) = ZMod.stdAddChar (k * j) := by rw [neg_neg, mul_comm]
      rw [e1, e2]
      ring
    simp only [e]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have e2 : ∀ j : ZMod N, ∑ k : ZMod N, Φ i * (starRingEnd ℂ) (Φ j) * ZMod.stdAddChar (k * (j - i)) = Φ i * (starRingEnd ℂ) (Φ j) * (if j = i then (N : ℂ) else 0) := by
      intro j
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, AddChar.sum_mulShift (j - i) (ZMod.isPrimitive_stdAddChar N)]
      simp [sub_eq_zero, ZMod.card]
    simp only [e2, mul_ite, mul_zero]
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ i]
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    rw [Complex.mul_conj]
    ring
  exact_mod_cast hc
target_source: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (Φ : ZMod N → ℂ), ∑ k, Complex.normSq (ZMod.dft Φ k) = (N : ℝ) * ∑ j, Complex.normSq (Φ j)
